questions.stem: What type of bond is formed between two nitrogen atoms in a nitrogen molecule?
questions.solution: Nitrogen atoms form a triple bond because each has three unpaired electrons that can be shared, resulting in three pairs of shared electrons. A single bond involves one pair, a double bond involves two pairs, and a quadruple bond would require more electrons than nitrogen can provide. A triple bond is the most stable and accurate representation of the bond between two nitrogen atoms.

questions.stem: What happens when a micelle is formed in water?
questions.solution: A micelle is formed when soap molecules arrange themselves in a way that the hydrophobic part surrounds the oil, allowing it to be dissolved in water. The other options are incorrect because micelles do not directly help in removing dirt, forming soap, or forming scum.

questions.stem: If a molecule of carbon dioxide has the formula CO₂, how many oxygen atoms are present in the molecule?
questions.solution: The formula CO₂ indicates that there is one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms in a molecule of carbon dioxide. The subscript 2 after the oxygen symbol represents two oxygen atoms.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a functional group?
questions.solution: An alcohol group is a functional group because it consists of an oxygen atom bonded to a hydrogen atom (—OH), which gives the molecule specific chemical properties. A carbon chain is just a series of carbon atoms and does not define the chemical behavior of a compound. A hydrogen atom alone does not act as a functional group, and a single bond is a type of chemical bond, not a group of atoms.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक क्रियात्मक समूह है?
hi.solution: एल्कोहॉल समूह एक क्रियात्मक समूह है क्योंकि यह एक ऑक्सीजन परमाणु जो एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु से बंधा होता है (—OH) के बना होता है, जो अणु के विशिष्ट रासायनिक गुण प्रदान करता है। कार्बन श्रृंखला केवल कार्बन परमाणुओं की श्रृंखला होती है और यह यौगिक के रासायनिक व्यवहार को परिभाषित नहीं करती। एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु अकेले क्रियात्मक समूह के रूप में कार्य नहीं करता है, और एकल बंध एक प्रकार का रासायनिक बंध है, समूह के परमाणु नहीं।
hi.critique: Translation accurately reflects the original meaning, technical terms are appropriate for Hindi-medium curriculum, and the correct answer remains option (3) as in the original.

questions.stem: Which of the following compounds is a homologous series member of propanol?
questions.solution: Butanol is a homologous series member of propanol as it has one more carbon atom. Ethanol is a lower homologue, butanone is a ketone, and pentanoic acid is a carboxylic acid.

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains why ethanoic acid is called glacial acetic acid?
choices: It is a solid at room temperature
It has a very high boiling point
questions.solution: Ethanoic acid is called glacial acetic acid because it freezes at 290 K, which is its melting point. This property causes it to form ice-like crystals when cooled, resembling glacial ice. The other options are incorrect because ethanoic acid is a liquid at room temperature, has a moderate boiling point, and is not particularly reactive under normal conditions.

questions.stem: If a molecule has a triple bond between two atoms, how many shared pairs of electrons are involved in the bond?
questions.solution: A triple bond involves three shared pairs of electrons because each bond is formed by one pair of electrons, and a triple bond consists of three such bonds. A single bond has one pair, a double bond has two pairs, and a triple bond has three pairs. The other options represent the number of pairs in single or double bonds, not triple bonds.

hi.stem: यदि एक अणु में दो परमाणुओं के बीच एक त्रिक बंध होता है, तो बंध में कितने साझा इलेक्ट्रॉन युग्म शामिल होते हैं?

questions.stem: If a hydrocarbon has the formula C5H12, what is the nature of the bonds in this compound?
questions.solution: C5H12 is an alkane, which consists entirely of single bonds between carbon atoms. Alkanes follow the general formula CnH2n+2, indicating no double or triple bonds. Double or triple bonds would result in a different molecular formula, making the other options incorrect.

hi.solution: C5H12 एक एल्केन है, जिसमें कार्बन परमाणुओं के बीच केवल एकल बंध होते हैं। एल्केन सामान्य सूत्र CnH2n+2 का अनुसरण करते हैं, जो द्विबंध या त्रिबंध के अभाव को दर्शाता है। द्विबंध या त्रिबंध के कारण अणु सूत्र अलग हो जाएगा, इसलिए अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं।

questions.stem: Which of the following is the main reason that soaps form scum in hard water?

They react with calcium and magnesium ions

questions.stem: Why is the structure of graphite different from that of diamond, even though both are made of carbon?
choices: Because of different bonding between carbon atoms
questions.solution: The correct answer is because of different bonding between carbon atoms. In diamond, carbon atoms form a rigid three-dimensional network with strong covalent bonds, while in graphite, carbon atoms form layered structures with weaker bonds between the layers. This difference in bonding explains their distinct structures and properties.

questions.stem: A compound has the formula C6H12. What can be inferred about its structure?
questions.solution: The compound C6H12 has a molecular formula that matches the general formula for alkenes, CnH2n, which indicates the presence of one double bond. A compound with only single bonds would have the formula C6H14, matching alkanes, while two double bonds or a triple bond would result in a different hydrogen count. Therefore, the correct inference is that it has one double bond.

hi.stem: एक यौगिक का सूत्र C6H12 है। इसकी संरचना के बारे में क्या निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है?
hi.solution: यौगिक C6H12 का अणुसूत्र एल्कीन के सामान्य सूत्र CnH2n के अनुरूप है, जो एक द्विबंध की उपस्थिति को इंगित करता है। केवल एकल बंध वाले यौगिक का सूत्र C6H14 होगा, जो एल्केन के सामान्य सूत्र के अनुरूप है, जबकि दो द्विबंध या एक त्रिबंध के कारण हाइड्रोजन की संख्या अलग होगी। इसलिए, सही निष्कर्ष यह है कि इसमें एक द्विबंध है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for chemical structures.

mr.stem: एका यौगिकाचे सूत्र C6H12 आहे. त्याच्या संरचनेबद्दल काय निष्कर्ष काढता येईल?
mr.solution: C6H12 यौगिकाचे अणुसूत्र अल्कीनच्या सामान्य सूत्राशी जुळते, CnH2n, जे द्विबंध उपस्थितीचा संकेत देते. केवळ एकांतर बंध असलेल्या यौगिकाचे सूत्र C6H14 असेल, जे अल्केनशी जुळते, तर दोन द्विबंध किंवा एक त्रिबंध असल्यास हायड्रोजनची संख्या वेगळी असेल. म्हणून, योग्य निष्कर्ष असा आहे की त्यामध्ये एक द्विबंध असेल.
